# openwrt_sys_modprobe (Resource)

Loads or unloads a kernel module on the OpenWrt device.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the kernel module to load/unload.

### Optional

- `action` (String) Action to perform: 'load' or 'unload'.
- `param` (Map of String) Module parameters as key-value pairs.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: sys_modprobe/<module_name>.
- `output` (String) Output from the modprobe command.
